newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iran raises Q4 Heavy formula, Light unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Iran raises Q4 Heavy formula, Light unchanged.

text.p: The state-owned National Iranian Oil Co (NIOC) has raised its crude pricing formula for Iranian Heavy by 10 cents a barrel for the fourth quarter of 1996 for Asian customers, traders in Tokyo said on Tuesday.
It maintained the Iranian Light formula, they said.
For the October-December term, Iranian Heavy has been set at Dubai quotations minus 13 cents per barrel, with an automatic adjustment factor then subtracted.

The third quarter formula for Iranian Heavy was initially set at Dubai quotations minus 33 cents. However, Iran later revised the formula to Dubai quotations minus 23 cents for August and September, traders said.
Iranian Light remained unchanged at Oman's MPM minus 12 cents, with the automatic adjustment factor then added.
According to traders, under a contractual agreement, NIOC and customers can review prices whenever the market moves substantially.
